title: Convolution-Free Holistic Multivariance Decomposition Layer for Efficient Hyperspectral Image Classification Tensor Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.16241v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Feature extraction for hyperspectral image classification is conventionally addressed using rigid tensor decompositions that fail to capture complex spatio-spectral interdependencies, or heavily parameterized convolutional neural networks that are computationally expensive. To overcome these limitations, this work introduces the Holistic Multivariance Decomposition (HMD) framework as a novel, end-to-end differentiable neural network layer. By explicitly separating independent single mode variations from cooperative higher dimensional interactions via learnable, matrix valued supports, the proposed HMD-0, HMD-1 and HMD-2 approximants are optimized jointly with a downstream classifier via backpropagation. translated_title: 无卷积整体多变量分解层用于高效高光谱图像分类的张量网络
translated_abstract: 高光谱图像分类的特征提取通常采用刚性张量分解方法，这些方法难以捕捉复杂的空间-光谱相互依赖关系，或者使用参数过多的卷积神经网络，计算成本高昂。为克服这些限制，本研究引入了整体多变量分解（HMD）框架，作为一种新颖的、端到端可微分的神经网络层。通过可学习的矩阵值支持，明确地将独立的单模态变化与协作的高维交互分离，所提出的HMD-0、HMD-1和HMD-2近似器与下游分类器通过反向传播联合优化。在三个基准高光谱数据集上的全面评估表明，与经典的基于可学习张量的基线（包括Tucker、Canonical Polyadic等）相比，更高级别的HMD层实现了更优越的分类精度。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无卷积的整体多变量分解层（HMD），通过可学习的矩阵值支持分离单模态与高维交互，在三个高光谱数据集上显著提升了分类精度，同时降低了计算复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a convolution-free Holistic Multivariance Decomposition (HMD) layer that separates single-mode variations from high-dimensional interactions via learnable matrix-valued supports, achieving superior classification accuracy on three hyperspectral datasets with reduced computational cost.
